crossRefs.note: Yahweh says, “Stand in the ways and see, and ask for the old paths, ‘Where is the good way?’ and walk in it, and you…
But they worship me in vain, teaching as doctrines the commandments of men.’
He received the sign of circumcision, a seal of the righteousness of the faith which he had while he was in…
He is the father of circumcision to those who not only are of the circumcision, but who also walk in the steps of that…
Now faith is assurance of things hoped for, proof of things not seen.
For by this, the elders obtained testimony.
These all, having had testimony given to them through their faith, didn’t receive the promise,

translations.web: No man having drunk old wine immediately desires new, for he says, ‘The old is better.’ ”
translations.bsb: And no one after drinking old wine wants new, for he says, ‘The old is better.’”
translations.kjv: No man also having drunk old wine straightway desireth new: for he saith, The old is better.
translations.asv: And no man having drunk old wine desireth new; for he saith, The old is good.
